description: Microcosm-BE: synthetic Belgian population calibrated to Belgian administrative and national-accounts targets (sums of Chronicle facts; surveys validation-only). Support records: US survey donor pool, reweighted; a Belgian donor pool is the planned upgrade. Cross-engine agreement is evidence about the encodings.
